gloss: to bear fruit; to ripen; to come to fruition

definitions.explanation: For plants to produce mature fruit or grain.

definitions.gloss: to come to fruition; to produce results
definitions.explanation: For efforts or plans to yield positive outcomes.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{稲|いね}が{実|みの}る。
{長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}がついに{実|みの}った。
examples.english: Years of hard work have finally borne fruit.

examples.japanese: {実|みの}るほど{頭|こうべ}を{垂|た}れる{稲穂|いなほ}かな。
examples.english: The more the rice ripens, the more it bows its head.

notes:
{実|みの}る is intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). There is no common transitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{実|みの}っている indicates the resulting state of having borne fruit.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {稲|いね}が{実|みの}る (rice ripens)
- {努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}る (efforts bear fruit)
- {愛|あい}が{実|みの}る (love comes to fruition)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～が{実|みの}る: What bears fruit or produces results

PROVERB:
「{実|みの}るほど{頭|こうべ}を{垂|た}れる{稲穂|いなほ}かな」 is a well-known saying teaching that truly accomplished people remain humble.

The figurative usage ({努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}る - efforts bear fruit) is very common and carries a positive connotation of success after hard work.
